comparison.objective: Scan four groceries exactly once and move them to a bagging shelf.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient varied objects for barcode visibility and relay them hand-to-hand across a scanner.
comparison.success_condition: Every item read exactly once and released on the shelf; unread transfer, duplicate reads, drops or falls fail.
comparison.reason: Tests perception-conditioned object orientation and relay transfer, not aperture-based mixture separation.
